Overview of Higher Education Scholarships

The Government of Maharashtra has officially released notifications regarding various prestigious scholarship programs for the 2026-27 academic year. These initiatives are designed to support meritorious students in pursuing higher education both within India and at international institutions.

Key Scholarship Schemes

The official portal of the Maharashtra Government (maharashtra.gov.in) lists the following major scholarship opportunities currently open for application:

  • Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh SARTHI Domestic Scholarship: Focused on supporting students pursuing higher education within India.
  • Maharaja Sayajirao Gaikwad SARTHI Scholarship: Dedicated to meritorious students seeking to pursue higher education abroad.
  • Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Foreign Scholarship: Specifically for students from Scheduled Castes (SC) looking to undertake specialized studies in foreign countries.

Practical Implications and Application Process

These schemes are part of the state's ongoing efforts to enhance academic accessibility for eligible candidates. Prospective applicants are advised to note the following requirements:

  • Eligibility: Candidates must meet specific academic and social category requirements as detailed in the individual scheme notifications.
  • Documentation: Applicants should be prepared to provide academic transcripts, proof of domicile, and caste verification documents where applicable.
  • Verification: Interested students should monitor the official website regularly for specific deadlines, detailed guidelines, and updated application links.

How to Verify Information

All official advertisements, corrigenda, and application forms are hosted on the Maharashtra Government's centralized official portal. Students are encouraged to:

  1. Visit the official website at https://maharashtra.gov.in/.
  2. Navigate to the 'Scholarships' or departmental notifications section.
  3. Verify the specific 'Notification ID' or reference number cited in the individual notices before submitting any personal information.
